metadata.description: Claude Code mods for long autonomous runs: git only when you ask (git-gate), live progress with mid-run answers (progress-pane), a model allow-list (model-guard) and handoffs between repos (handoff).

plugins.name: git-gate
plugins.description: Git only when you asked: commits, pushes, pull requests, merges and destructive git commands run only when your latest message (or /ship, /kickoff, or your answer to Claude's question) allowed them; everything else is refused with a note telling Claude to ask. No UI.

plugins.name: model-guard
plugins.description: Choose the model versions Claude and its subagents may use: /models lists the newest of each family from Anthropic's Models API (older versions one key away); block a version, or a family's new ones, and subagents, workflows and /model asking for it are refused or moved to an allowed version. One list shared by every Claude Code window on the machine; a repo can keep its own.

plugins.name: progress-pane
plugins.description: Mission control for long tasks, in a Notebook look: a validated worklog tool Claude updates at every step (done only after a green gate), facts the mod sees for itself (gate runs, commits, branch, agents, context and cost), drift hints where the two disagree, a band above the prompt, a /progress pane, and an Agents tab where every subagent has a pixel companion with its own progress, figures and log.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Hand work to another session or repo without copy-paste: /handoff writes a note from facts it gathers itself (branch, commits, PRs, worklog) plus a six-section narrative from a fork of the conversation, saves it under ~/.claude/handoffs, copies it, and /handoff pick inserts it in the other session; a waiting note for this repo shows as a toast.
